items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each guard is two lines with a clear comment, `# Don't overwrite a value that has been prefetched already.`, followed by `continue`. Naming and formatting match the surrounding descriptor code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing field cache API (`is_cached`) instead of adding new bookkeeping. The same small guard is applied consistently in three parallel loops. No dead code, and the temporary test file was deleted.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The change adds no error handling and no magic constants. When nothing is cached, the parent is still assigned exactly as before, so the default path is unchanged. Hidden tests pass, including all 85 P2P tests.

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: All three loops are guarded with an is_cached-style check: `if self.field.is_cached(rel_obj): continue` in the reverse-FK manager, plus matching guards in `ReverseOneToOneDescriptor` and `ForwardManyToOneDescriptor`. The parent is still set when not cached, so the one-to-one case from the issue is handled explicitly.
